title: NPDev External AI Mission Profile
description: A declared unit of work an external AI may be asked to judge (ADR-0009): what pack it gets, what it must never be shown, and which case (platform dogfood or product feature) it closes. Catalog entries like M1-SEC-GENCODE / M7-IMPACT-CONVERT are instances of this shape.

instance.description: platform = NPDev's own dogfood review; product = an app author's own feature use; both = the same mission shape serves either.

closes.description: Which inventory case this satisfies, e.g. 'E1 s.1' or 'calibration' -- free text referencing PLAN_EXTERNAL_AI_REVIEW's case inventory. A calibration mission closes nothing externally-facing; it establishes the control.

isCalibration.description: True for M0-CALIB-* missions run against the pre-fix parent commit of a known bug, per ADR-0009's control requirement (P4). A calibration mission's result is a yield score, not a finding.

packContents.description: What the pack deliberately includes, in curator-facing terms (e.g. 'DefaultConceptGateway.java (595 ln)').

excluded.description: What the pack deliberately withholds (e.g. our own conclusions, the register, prior findings docs). Never empty for a real (non-calibration) mission -- curation without an excluded list is not curation.

minVendors.description: Security missions require >=2 per the plan's multi-vendor-by-design hazard mitigation.

gitPinned.description: Whether the pack must be built from an explicit git revision (git show <rev>:<path>), not the working tree -- required for any mission that targets NPDev's own historical source.

sourceCommit.description: Git revision this mission's platform-git paths are pinned to (only meaningful when gitPinned is true and instance is platform/both) -- e.g. a calibration mission's pre-fix parent commit. Absent for missions whose content is not git-sourced.

paths.description: Repo-relative paths the platform producer (scripts/external-review/build-review-pack.py) reads for this mission. Empty or absent for missions whose content is per-generated-app or per-app-runtime (M1, M6, M7) -- those are supplied via --paths at build time instead.
